properties.name: Bunker presso Pasadur
properties.function: Small, hidden underground shelter. Build out of reinforced concrete, camouflaged with rocks. 1 tiny, empty room, no door - approx. place for 2 laying or 4 sitting or 6 standing people. Structure is intact & it's safe to enter (08/2022).

properties.name: Centar Veza
properties.function: "Connection Center" - an abandoned small communication bunker/fallout shelter (several old antenna on mountaintop) of ex-JNA. Built a unit with the nearby command bunker. Access is locked & only accessible by guided tour.
properties.period_note: Esercito popolare jugoslavo (JNA) o posto di frontiera, 1945–91

properties.name: Installazione sotterranea presso Uble
properties.function: Abandoned big command bunker/fallout shelter complex of ex-JNA. Facility uses the whole mountaintop (several access, shafts, antenna, one shielded lookout etc.). All access are locked and complex is accessible by guided tours only.
